title: Modified Three Peaks Protocol for Power Soil DNA Isolation Kit
author: Chiara Mazzoni
materials: The DNA is now ready for downstream applications.

steps.title: Initial Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Combine 200 mg of fresh stool with 400 uL of DNA/RNA Shield in set 1 (1 stool : 2 solvent ratio) and vortex briefly.

steps.title: First Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 5,000 rcf for 00:05:00 and transfer up to all 400 uL of the DNA/RNA Shield supernatant to set 2.

steps.title: Stool Resuspension
steps.instruction: Combine the remaining stool pellet with 200 uL of PBS (1 stool : 1 solvent ratio) and resuspend using 1000P pipetting.

steps.title: Second Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5,000 x rcf for 00:05:00 and transfer up to all 200 uL of the PBS supernatant to set 2.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add 700 uL PBS and 3-4 sterilised glass beads to the pellet. Homogenize on a Tissue lyser for 2 min at speed 25 to suspend the sample and detach microbiota from dietary fibres; repeat until faecal pellets are completely dissolved.

steps.title: Low-Speed Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at low speed (35 rcf, 20 min) to separate larger fecal particles from bacteria. Transfer as much supernatant as possible (~600 uL) to set 3 and discard set 1 (containing glass beads and debris).

steps.title: Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 10 uL of MetaPolyzyme (60 solvent : 1 enzyme ratio) to set 3 and mix by gentle 1000P pipetting. Incubate at 35 °C for 3 h with no agitation to form spheroplasts.

steps.title: Chemical Lysis
steps.instruction: Add 60 uL 10 % (w/v) SDS and 60 uL of Proteinase K [20 mg/mL] (10 solvent:1 chemical:1 enzyme ratio) and mix by gentle 1000P pipetting. Incubate at 55 °C for 00:30:00 with 300 rpm agitation.

steps.title: Homogenization and Supernatant Transfer
steps.instruction: Gently mix by flicking to ensure the solution is homogeneous. Centrifuge at 5,000 rcf for 00:05:00 and transfer up to ~600 uL of the PBS supernatant to set 4.

steps.title: Bead-Beating Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet of set 3 in 00 uL of C1 Lysis Solution (Power Soil Kit). Transfer to a PowerBead Tube, vortex briefly, and bead-beat on a Vortex adapter for 5 minutes at speed 10.

steps.title: Final Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 15,000 rcf for 00:02:00 and transfer all the C1 Lysis Solution to set 5.

steps.title: DNA Purification (Sets 2, 4, and 5)
steps.instruction: Perform the following purification steps on set 2, set 4, and set 5 separately:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 rcf for 00:01:00. Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 700 µl of supernatant (expect 500–600 µl) to a clean 2 ml Microcentrifuge Tube.
Add 200 µl of Solution CD2 and invert the tube 5 times to precipitate non-DNA material.
Add Solution CD3 in a 1:1 ratio (600 µl) and invert the tube 5 times. (Note: If step 23 was run twice, add 900 uL of Solution CD3 instead).
Load 650-670 uL of the lysate onto an MB Spin Column and centrifuge at 15,000 rcf for 00:01:00. Discard flow-through and repeat with remaining lysate.
Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube. Add 500 uL of Solution EA and centrifuge at 15,000 rcf for 00:01:00. Discard flow-through.
Place the MB Spin Column back into the same 2 ml Collection Tube. Add 500 uL of Solution C5 and centrifuge at 15,000 rcf for 00:01:00. Discard flow-through.
Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube and centrifuge at up to 16,000 rcf for 00:02:00 to remove all traces of Solution C5.

Transfer the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 ml Elution Tube. Add 70 uL (range 50-100 uL) of Solution C6 (10 mM Tris) to the center of the white filter membrane and centrifuge at 15,000 rcf for 00:01:00.
